BRUSSELS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Verlinvest, the global, family-backed consumer-focused evergreen investment company, today announced it has entered into an agreement to acquire China Resources Enterprise, Limited’s (“China Resources”) indirect interests in Oatly Group AB (publ) (Nasdaq: OTLY) (“Oatly”), the world’s original and largest oat drink company. The transaction builds on Verlinvest’s investment in Oatly since 2016 and reinforces its conviction in the company’s long-term potential.

A change in strategic direction of state-owned enterprise China Resources informed its decision to fully exit its investment in Oatly. China Resources worked constructively with Verlinvest to identify the best path for it to do so in recognition of the complexity of their joint holding structure.

Under the agreement, Verlinvest will acquire China Resources’ indirect interests in Oatly’s equity and convertible instruments that are currently held through Verlinvest and China Resources’ joint venture vehicle, Nativus Company Limited.

The transaction reflects the complexity of the Nativus ownership structure and under Swedish law, Verlinvest is required, as a condition to the transaction, to make a tender offer to all Oatly shareholders and holders of American Depositary Shares (ADSs). The tender offer commenced today. The tender offer price reflects the agreed terms and complex structure of Verlinvest’s transaction with China Resources and should not be interpreted as reflecting the fair value of Oatly’s shares or Verlinvest’s view of Oatly’s prospects. Verlinvest recommends that Oatly shareholders and holders of ADSs do not tender their shares or ADSs.

As a result of the transaction, Verlinvest’s ownership is expected to increase to approximately 42.6% of Oatly’s share capital. Verlinvest intends to continue working closely with Oatly’s management team and independent directors to support the company’s profitable growth strategy. China Resources’ three Board representatives are expected to step down from the Board following completion of the transaction. Verlinvest does not intend to take Oatly private or delist its ADSs from Nasdaq, upon completion of the transaction.

Roberto Italia, Chief Executive Officer of Verlinvest, said: “We first invested in Oatly ten years ago, when it was generating around $50 million in revenue, because we saw the brand at the forefront of a profound global shift towards taste-led, healthier and more sustainable food choices. Since then, Oatly has become an iconic, category-defining, global brand, generating over $860 million in revenue in 2025, and our conviction in its long-term potential is as strong as ever. Our decision to increase our investment reflects our confidence in Oatly’s management team, profitable growth strategy and the opportunities ahead.”

About Verlinvest

Verlinvest is an international, family-backed evergreen investment company. Verlinvest identifies inflection points in consumer behaviours and partners with the businesses driving these consumer revolutions forward while having a positive impact. Established in 1995, with offices in Brussels, London, New York, Singapore, and Mumbai, Verlinvest focuses on the FMCG, health, consumer technology and lifestyle categories, investing across three strategies: Venture, Growth, and Platform — from early-stage backing through large-scale brand building. The company has over €2.5bn in AUM and counts brands such as Oatly, Vita Coco, Tony’s Chocolonely, Purplle, K1 Speed, Mutti, Who Gives A Crap, and Insomnia Cookies among its portfolio, alongside alumni Chewy, Sula, and Vitaminwater. Further information is available at www.verlinvest.com.

Key Terms

tender offerfinancial
A tender offer is a proposal made by a person or company to buy shares from existing shareholders at a set price, usually higher than the current market value, within a specific time frame. It matters to investors because it can lead to a change in ownership or control of a company, and shareholders must decide whether to sell their shares at the offered price.

american depositary shares (ads)financial
American depositary shares (ADS) are a way for investors in the United States to buy shares of foreign companies without dealing with the complexities of international markets. They represent ownership in a foreign company's stock and are traded on U.S. exchanges, making it easier and more convenient for Americans to invest internationally. ADSs allow investors to diversify their portfolios with foreign companies while using familiar trading platforms.
convertible instrumentsfinancial
Convertible instruments are loans or special stock that can be changed into ordinary shares under set conditions, like a loan with an option to become ownership. They matter to investors because they balance downside protection (you often get interest or priority) with upside potential (they can turn into equity if a company does well), and they can change how many shares exist and how much each share is worth.

ROCKVILLE, Md., Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Theriva™ Biologics, Inc. (NYSE American: TOVX), a diversified clinical-stage company developing therapeutics designed to treat cancer and related diseases in areas of high unmet need, announced today a reverse stock split of its authorized and issued and outstanding common stock, par value $0.001 per share, at a ratio of one (1) share of common stock for every thirty (30) shares of common stock, effective as of 11:59 p.m. (Eastern Time) on December 1, 2026 (the “Effective Date”).

The Company’s common stock will begin trading on a split-adjusted basis when the market opens on December 2, 2026. The reverse stock split was authorized by the Company’s Board of Directors on November 13, 2026. Pursuant to the laws of the State of Nevada, the Company’s state of incorporation, the Company’s Board of Directors has the authority to effect a reverse stock split without shareholder approval if the number of authorized shares of common stock and the number of outstanding shares of common stock are proportionally reduced. The Company will file a certificate of change to its articles of incorporation, as amended, with the Secretary of State of Nevada to effect the reverse stock split. The Company’s common stock will continue to trade on the NYSE American under the stock ticker “TOVX” but will trade under the new CUSIP number 87164U607.

As a result of the reverse split, each thirty (30) pre-split shares of common stock outstanding will automatically combine into one (1) new share of common stock without any action on the part of the holders, and the number of outstanding common shares will be reduced from 45,892,668 shares to approximately 1,529,756 shares without taking into account fractional shares. The number of authorized shares of common stock will be proportionally reduced from 350,000,000 shares to 11,666,666 shares.

The reverse stock split is being effected to ensure that the Company can meet the per share price requirements of the NYSE American, the Company's current listing exchange.

No fractional shares will be issued as a result of the reverse stock split. Stockholders who otherwise would be entitled to a fractional share because they hold a number of shares not evenly divisible by the one (1) for thirty (30) reverse split ratio will automatically be entitled to receive an additional fractional share of the Company’s common stock to round up to the next whole share.

Proportionate adjustments will also be made to the number of shares of common stock issuable upon exercise of, and the exercise price of, the Company’s outstanding warrants and stock options, and to the number of shares of common stock reserved for issuance under the Company’s equity incentive plans.

The Company’s transfer agent, Equiniti Trust Company, which is also acting as the exchange agent for the reverse split, will send instructions to stockholders of record who hold stock certificates regarding the exchange of their old certificates for new certificates, should they wish to do so. Stockholders who hold their shares in brokerage accounts or “street name” are not required to take action to effect the exchange of their shares.

About Theriva™ Biologics, Inc.

Theriva™ Biologics (NYSE American: TOVX) is a diversified clinical-stage company developing therapeutics designed to treat cancer and related diseases in areas of high unmet need. The Company’s subsidiary Theriva Biologics, S.L., has been developing a new oncolytic adenovirus platform designed for intravenous (IV), intravitreal and intratumoral delivery to trigger tumor cell death, improve access of co-administered cancer therapies to the tumor, and promote a robust and sustained anti-tumor response by the patient’s immune system. The Company’s lead clinical-stage candidate is VCN-01 (zabilugene almadenorepvec), an oncolytic adenovirus designed to replicate selectively within tumor cells, and to degrade the tumor stroma barrier that serves as a significant physical and immunosuppressive barrier to cancer treatment. For more information, please visit Theriva™ Biologics’ website at www.therivabio.com.

LINCOLN, Neb.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--As Lincoln gets ready for the Ohio State-Nebraska matchup, Bloom Energy is joining the community off the field to recognize the firefighters and first responders who help keep Nebraska’s capital safe.

On Friday, Bloom Energy visited Lincoln Fire & Rescue Station #1 and presented the department with a $10,000 donation. The contribution recognizes the more than 300 Lincoln Fire & Rescue personnel serving the city across 16 fire stations and supports the department’s continued work protecting the Lincoln community.

“Lincoln’s firefighters have been called on in extraordinary ways this year, from responding to historic flooding to helping fight the largest wildfire in Nebraska’s history,” said Natalie Sunderland, Chief Marketing Officer at Bloom Energy. “We’re proud to recognize Lincoln Fire & Rescue and support the men and women who protect this community every day.”

“We’re very grateful to Bloom Energy for this opportunity. Employee well being is critical at Lincoln Fire and Rescue, but it’s not always something we have a lot of funding for when we also have equipment and other operational needs to prioritize,” said Dave Engler, Fire Chief, Lincoln Fire & Rescue. “This funding will allow us to invest directly in our members, whether that’s through physical and behavioral health programs, training and support following critical incidents, or resources to address challenges that come with shift work. We’re excited to put these dollars toward the health and well-being of our firefighters.”

Lincoln Fire & Rescue provides emergency services and community programs across the city. Its members also serve on specialized response teams, including Nebraska Task Force One.

This year, Lincoln firefighters have responded well beyond their day-to-day duties. In March, a Fire & Rescue crew deployed to Ogallala to help fight the largest wildfire in Nebraska’s history. In October, crews including the department’s Water Rescue Team rescued more than a dozen people during the flooding.

The donation reflects Bloom Energy’s commitment to supporting the communities it serves and recognizing the people and organizations that run essential services.

Bloom will also be on campus Saturday ahead of the Ohio State-Nebraska game as ESPN Radio’s College Football Campus Tour powered by Bloom Energy brings its live broadcast and interactive Fan Zone to Lincoln.

  • November 21 – Lincoln, Nebraska | Ohio State at Nebraska

SAN DIEGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Avenzo Therapeutics, Inc. (“Avenzo”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing next-generation oncology therapeutics, today announced the completion of its previously announced merger (the “Merger”) with Rallybio Corporation (“Rallybio”) (Nasdaq: RLYB), which closed on November 20, 2026. The combined company is operating under the name Avenzo Therapeutics, Inc., and its shares are expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market on November 23, 2026, under the ticker symbol AVZO. The combined company will be led by Athena Countouriotis, M.D., its Chair, President and Chief Executive Officer, and other members of the Avenzo management team.

“We are pleased to complete this merger and launch Avenzo as a public company, with a pipeline of four potentially best-in-class or first-in-class clinical stage product candidates,” said Dr. Countouriotis. “We are excited by the positive preliminary AVZO-1418 data we presented this week at ENA, and we look forward to two additional clinical data presentations before year-end: initial Phase 1 data for AVZO-103, to be presented by our partner VelaVigo, and updated Phase 1 data for AVZO-023. With our strong balance sheet, I believe Avenzo is well positioned to deliver much-needed therapies to patients and create meaningful value for our stakeholders.”

Recent AVZO-1418 Data Update

On November 18, 2026, Avenzo announced positive preliminary Phase 1 data from the AVENTINE-1 study of AVZO-1418, its potentially best-in-class EGFR/HER3 bispecific antibody-drug conjugate (ADC), at the 38th EORTC-NCI-AACR Symposium. The data showed responses in five of eight tumor types, including an objective response rate of 63% in 19 evaluable patients with heavily pretreated EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer, the majority of whom were receiving 3rd line or later treatment. AVZO-1418 also demonstrated a favorable safety profile with a low incidence of Grade 3/4 hematologic adverse events. Based on these results, Avenzo is pursuing a rapid development plan that includes global expansion and further evaluation of AVZO-1418 in multiple tumor types. Additional details are available in Avenzo’s November 18, 2026 press release.

Upcoming Data Presentations

Avenzo expects two additional clinical data presentations before year-end 2026. On December 4, 2026, Avenzo’s partner in China, VelaVigo, will present initial Phase 1 data for VBC-103 (known as AVZO-103 outside of Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan) in an oral presentation at ESMO Asia. On December 9, 2026, Avenzo will present updated Phase 1 data from the ORION-1 study of AVZO-023 in combination with fulvestrant at the San Antonio Breast Cancer Symposium.

Reverse Merger Closing Conditions

Immediately prior to the closing of the Merger, Avenzo completed a previously announced oversubscribed private placement financing generating approximately $215 million in gross proceeds, with participation from a syndicate of leading healthcare institutional investors and mutual funds. This financing, together with existing cash, is expected to fund operations into late 2028, including multiple anticipated clinical milestones.

Immediately following the closing of the Merger and giving effect to the previously announced 1-for-2 reverse stock split of Rallybio common stock, the combined company had approximately 104.2 million shares of common stock issued and outstanding. On a fully diluted basis using the treasury stock method, pre-Merger Avenzo equity holders (excluding their participation in the private placement) owned approximately 56.6%, pre-Merger Rallybio equity holders owned approximately 2.8%, and investors in the private placement owned approximately 40.6% of the combined company’s common stock.

In connection with the Merger, Rallybio previously announced a special cash distribution of $83.6 million, or $13.90 per share, payable to stockholders and pre-funded warrant holders of record as of November 5, 2026, subject to Nasdaq due bill procedures. Shares of Rallybio common stock traded during the period from November 5, 2026, through the close of trading on November 20, 2026, carried due bills entitling buyers, rather than sellers, to the distribution, even if settlement occurs later. Accordingly, Rallybio common stockholders must have held their shares through the close of trading on November 20, 2026, to be entitled to the distribution. November 23, 2026 is expected to be the first day the combined company’s common stock will trade ex-dividend under the ticker symbol AVZO; purchasers on or after that date will not be entitled to receive the distribution on those shares. The scheduled distribution payment date is November 30, 2026.

In addition, eligible holders of Rallybio securities are expected to receive contingent value rights (CVRs) providing for potential payments from the monetization of Rallybio’s legacy assets, subject to the terms and conditions of the CVR agreement.

Conference Call and Webcast

Avenzo will host a listen-only conference call and audio webcast on Monday, November 23, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. EST to discuss the closing of the Merger and the combined company’s pipeline and clinical development plans. There will be no question-and-answer session.

The webcast will be available on the company’s website, www.avenzotx.com, under the Events & Presentations section. Participants may also listen by phone by dialing +1 833-461-5787 (U.S. toll-free) or +1 585-542-9983 (international) and referencing conference ID 270 779 804.

An archived replay of the webcast will be available on the website for approximately 90 days following the call.

Advisors

Leerink Partners served as exclusive financial advisor to Avenzo. Evercore served as lead financial advisor and Citizens Capital Markets & Advisory served as co-financial advisor to Rallybio. Cooley LLP served as legal counsel to Avenzo. Ropes & Gray LLP served as legal counsel to Rallybio.

Leerink Partners, Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC, Piper Sandler, and Guggenheim Securities served as placement agents for the private placement, and Mintz, Levin, Cohn, Ferris, Glovsky and Popeo, P.C. served as legal counsel to the placement agents.

About Avenzo Therapeutics

Avenzo Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing next-generation oncology therapeutics for patients. The company’s pipeline includes potentially best-in-class small molecules and bispecific antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). Avenzo’s small molecule inhibitors, AVZO-021 and AVZO-023, are novel, highly potent and selective inhibitors of CDK2 and CDK4, respectively, which are key enzymes involved in cell cycle regulation. AVZO-021 is being evaluated in a Phase 1/2 study as monotherapy in advanced solid tumors and in combination with fulvestrant in HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer. AVZO-021 and AVZO-023 are being evaluated in the Phase 1/2 ORION-1 study in patients with HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer, with AVZO-023 administered in combination with endocrine therapy, with or without AVZO-021. Avenzo’s first ADC drug candidate, AVZO-1418, is an EGFR/HER3 bispecific ADC that is being studied in the AVENTINE-1 Phase 1/2 study for the treatment of solid tumors. Avenzo’s second ADC drug candidate, AVZO-103, is a Nectin4/TROP2 bispecific ADC that is being studied in the BEACON-1 Phase 1/2 study for the treatment of advanced solid tumors. Avenzo is headquartered in San Diego, California. For more information, visit www.avenzotx.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

Key Terms

antibody-drug conjugatemedical
An antibody-drug conjugate is a targeted medicine that combines an antibody, which can identify specific cells, with a powerful drug designed to destroy those cells. This approach allows for precise treatment, minimizing damage to healthy tissue. For investors, developments in this area can signal advances in cancer therapies and potential growth opportunities in the biotech sector.
objective response ratemedical
The objective response rate (ORR) is the percentage of patients in a clinical trial whose tumors measurably shrink or disappear according to preset rules. Investors use it as a quick, objective signal of a drug’s ability to produce a clear treatment effect—like counting how many plants visibly respond after applying a new fertilizer—and higher ORR can improve odds of regulatory approval, commercial success, and company valuation.
contingent value rightsfinancial
Contingent value rights are special financial instruments that give their holder the potential to receive additional payments if certain future events or conditions happen, such as the achievement of specific business milestones. They are like a promise of extra rewards that depend on how well a project or company performs later on. Investors care about them because they offer a chance for extra gains but also carry uncertainty, as the extra payments are not guaranteed.
treasury stock methodfinancial
A bookkeeping technique used to estimate how many additional shares would exist if all outstanding stock options, warrants and convertible securities were exercised, assuming the company uses the cash received to buy back shares at the current market price. Investors use it to calculate diluted earnings per share and to gauge potential ownership and profit dilution—like figuring out how a pie would be divided if more people claimed slices and some money was used to buy slices back.
due billsfinancial
Due bills are short-term promises to pay for goods or services received earlier but not yet paid for. They act like an IOU, indicating that the buyer owes money to the seller. For investors, due bills matter because they can affect the timing of payments and the true value of a transaction, impacting financial clarity and decision-making.

XIAN, China, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Bon Natural Life Limited (NASDAQ: BON) ("BON" or the "Company"), a leading provider of bio-ingredient solutions for the natural, health, and personal care industries, today announced that its subsidiary, Xi'an App-Chem Bio (Tech) Co., Ltd. ("App-Chem") recently convened a symposium with China Oat Group Co., Ltd. ("China Oat Group") on the theme of "Advancing the High-Quality Development of China's Health Industry". At the event, the two parties announced the establishment of the BON Natural Ingredients and Biomanufacturing Joint Laboratory (the "BON Joint Lab" or the "Joint Lab").

Through an innovative collaboration model, the BON Joint Lab aims to build an integrated innovation framework spanning the entire value chain, from fundamental research and pilot-scale development to standard-setting and industrial commercialization. The Joint Lab will focus on developing an AI-driven technological platform for the biomanufacturing of natural ingredients, with synthetic biology serving as its technological foundation and artificial intelligence (AI) as a key competitive differentiator. Its primary focus will be the development of biomanufacturing technologies for high-value natural ingredients. This integrated technological framework is expected to enhance the Joint Lab's competitive position in the natural ingredients biomanufacturing sector while offering the industry new alternatives to conventional production methods.

Oats are widely recognized for their nutritional value and health benefits. They contain bioactive compounds such as beta-glucan and avenanthramides (AVAs), which have demonstrated various biological activities, including cardiovascular protection, blood glucose regulation, antioxidant effects, and anti-inflammatory properties. As a supplier of oat-based health products, China Oat Group serves a market characterized by strong demand and significant growth potential. However, limited availability of natural raw materials and high sourcing costs have constrained the broader commercial application and market expansion of oat-derived products.

Through the establishment of the Joint Lab, BON and China Oat Group aim to develop biomanufacturing technologies for oat-derived natural ingredients, with the goal of fundamentally addressing challenges related to supply availability, supply stability, and high production costs. BON and China Oat Group believe that this initiative is of significant importance in expanding the market for oat-derived natural ingredients.

Standards development plays a critical role in the biomanufacturing of natural ingredients. The unique complexity of natural ingredient sourcing, heightened regulatory scrutiny of product safety, and distinct consumer preferences for naturally derived ingredients make the establishment of standards for biomanufactured natural ingredients critically important to their commercial value.

BON and China Oat Group have undertaken extensive and productive work in developing quality standards for natural ingredients. The Joint Lab will make standards development a dedicated area of focus, conducting systematic testing and validation of key parameters, including ingredient purity, safety, and elemental and isotopic profiles. Through a comprehensive and integrated process of evaluation and optimization, the Joint Lab aims to establish systematic differentiation in product standards across multiple dimensions, including safety, differentiated quality standards, and similarity to naturally derived counterparts.

BON has established a strong presence in the natural ingredients biomanufacturing sector and has articulated its vision of becoming an "AI-driven pioneer in digital nutrition". The Company is committed to accelerating the transition from conventional natural extraction methods to AI-driven biomanufacturing. The Company believes that it has built a strong technological foundation in natural products, biosynthesis, and the application of AI in biology, supported by robust industrialization capabilities and global market development expertise.

China Oat Group has developed extensive expertise across the entire oat value chain and holds more than ten invention patents in China, along with multiple patents in the United States, Europe, Canada, Australia, and other markets. Leveraging its advanced technologies in areas such as oat protein enzymatic hydrolysis and the preservation of beta-glucan bioactivity, China Oat Group has developed a portfolio of oat-based nutritional products whose health benefits have been evaluated through medical research. China Oat Group was also among the first companies to achieve large-scale, standardized deep processing of oats, with its related technologies receiving authoritative certifications in Europe and the United States.

Mr. Yongwei Hu, Chairman of BON, commented, "Our strategic collaboration with China Oat Group marks a pivotal step in our efforts to establish a stronger presence in the core natural ingredients sector, accelerate our expansion into the rapidly growing global biomanufacturing market, and further strengthen our position as an innovation leader in the industry. Through the Joint Lab, we aim to advance cutting-edge research in areas such as the biosynthesis of high-value natural ingredients, the discovery of functional bioactive compounds, and precision nutrition interventions. We are committed to accelerating the commercialization of scientific and technological innovations and delivering a broader range of safe and effective health solutions to consumers. Through the disciplined execution of our technology-driven business strategy, we seek to unlock significant commercial value and generate sustainable returns for our investors."

NEW YORK, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Peloton Interactive, Inc. (“Peloton”) (NASDAQ: PTON) today announced it has successfully completed a global refinancing that reduced overall debt and extended debt maturities.

Summary of Transactions

  • Peloton entered into a new $200 million five-year revolving credit facility led by Goldman Sachs, which replaced Peloton’s existing $100 million five-year revolving credit facility.
  • Peloton repaid all term loans outstanding under its existing $1 billion five-year term loan facility and terminated the facility.

(OTCQB:FTCO) (the "Company") announced the closing of a $10 million Private Placement (the "Placement"), selling 2.8 million unregistered shares of its common stock at $3.57 per share (the closing price on November 17, 2026) to Hawthorne Land and Minerals LLC ("Hawthorne"). There were no placement or agent fees paid by the Company associated with the Placement. The proceeds of the Placement are earmarked for several projects including the continuation of the Isabella Pearl heap leach pad expansion, the ordering of longer lead-time equipment and materials for the projected 2027 Golden Mile Mine build, and for general working capital purposes. Fortitude Gold is a gold producer, developer, and explorer with operations in Nevada, U.S.A. offering investors exposure to both gold production and dividend yield.

The proceeds of the Placement are to be used for numerous projects. The Isabella Pearl heap leach pad expansion continues and is estimated to be completed in early 2027. The Company's proposed Golden Mile Mine, which is nearing the final phases of permitting, requires longer lead-time components, including a crushing facility. The Company made the decision in late 2025 to install and commission the originally purchased Golden Mile crushing circuit into the Isabella Pearl process facility to accommodate higher estimated mineral tonnages from both Isabella Pearl and County Line.

"We are pleased with this Placement which aids us in advancing Fortitude's new mines, expanding our processing facility's heap leach pad for additional longevity, and strengthens our financial position as we look to place our new Golden Mile Mine into production once the final permits are obtained," stated Fortitude Gold CEO and President, Mr. Jason Reid.

Mr. Reid continued, "We don't take shareholder dilution lightly, and we are still very proud to have one of the tightest capital structures for a producer in the mining space with just 31,391,248 outstanding shares of common stock after this Placement. On behalf of the Board, management, and the team here at Fortitude Gold, I would like to thank Hawthorne for their continued support."

Fortitude Gold is a U.S. based gold producer targeting projects with low operating costs, high margins, and strong returns on capital. CORAL GABLES, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- MasTec, Inc. (NYSE: MTZ) today announced the completion of its previously announced acquisition of Murphy Corporation (“Murphy”), one of the nation’s leading mechanical infrastructure contractors.

The acquisition expands MasTec’s capabilities across mission-critical and industrial infrastructure markets and adds a highly skilled union workforce and differentiated mechanical, engineering, preconstruction, virtual design and fabrication capabilities. Murphy also brings a substantial service and maintenance business that MasTec believes is well positioned to benefit from growing demand to support operational data centers and other large-load facilities.

“We are excited to officially welcome the Murphy team to MasTec,” said Jose Mas, Chief Executive Officer of MasTec. “The combination brings together two organizations with highly complementary capabilities and a shared commitment to safety, operational excellence and customer service. We believe Murphy is an exceptional strategic fit for MasTec, and we look forward to supporting the team as they build upon Murphy’s more than 100-year history and pursue the significant opportunities ahead.”

Murphy will continue to operate under its existing leadership as a new MasTec operating group, with its financial results expected to be included in MasTec’s Clean Energy and Infrastructure segment.

About MasTec

MasTec, Inc. is a leading North American infrastructure engineering and construction company focused primarily on engineering, building, installation, maintenance and upgrade of communications, energy and utility and other infrastructure. MasTec primarily operates under four business segments including Communications, serving both wireless and wireline/fiber infrastructure; Power Delivery, serving primarily utility customers in transmission, distribution and large load electrical infrastructure markets; Pipeline Infrastructure serving energy and other customers with installation and maintenance services primarily for natural gas pipeline and distribution infrastructure; and Clean Energy and Infrastructure, providing renewable energy engineering and construction services, as well as for heavy civil and other industrial infrastructure markets. Learn more at www.mastec.com.

PHILADELPHIA, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Board of Trustees of abrdn Income Credit Strategies Fund (NYSE: ACP) has approved a 1-for-4 reverse stock split of the Fund's issued and outstanding common shares, effective prior to the opening of trading on December 7, 2026.

The Board approved the reverse stock split to increase the Fund's per-share market price. The Board believes a higher share price may reduce certain trading and administrative frictions associated with lower-priced securities, increase the Fund's suitability for certain investment platforms and intermediary programs, and better align the Fund's share price with industry trading conventions.

The aggregate value of a shareholder's investment is not expected to change solely as a result of the reverse stock split, although the market value of Fund shares will continue to fluctuate based on market conditions.

Under the terms of the transaction, every four common shares will be consolidated into one common share. No fractional shares will be issued; fractional share entitlements will be aggregated and sold, with the net proceeds distributed to affected shareholders. The transaction will apply equally to all shareholders and will not affect any shareholder's proportionate ownership interest, other than minor adjustments resulting from the treatment of fractional shares.

Following the transaction, the Fund's common shares will continue to trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol ACP. A new CUSIP number will be assigned to the Fund.

The reverse stock split will not alter the Fund's current distribution policy. The Fund currently pays a monthly distribution of $0.055 per common share, which represented an annualized distribution rate of approximately 12.5% of the Fund's net asset value as of September 10, 2026. After giving effect to the 1-for-4 reverse stock split, the monthly distribution is expected to adjust proportionately to $0.22 per common share, subject to declaration by the Board. This proportional adjustment is not expected to change the aggregate distribution received by a shareholder solely as a result of the reverse stock split, other than with respect to fractional shares.

Shareholders holding shares through a brokerage account will generally have their holdings adjusted automatically. Shareholders holding physical share certificates or those with questions regarding their account should contact the Fund's transfer agent, Computershare Trust Company, N.A. Please refer to the contact details at the end of this release.

Important Information

Shares of closed-end funds are listed for trading on national securities exchanges and are bought and sold in the secondary market. The market price of a fund's shares is determined by supply and demand and may be greater than (a "premium") or less than (a "discount") the fund's net asset value (NAV). A fund's investment return and principal value will fluctuate, and investors may receive more or less than their original investment upon the sale of shares. There is no assurance that a fund will achieve its investment objective. Past performance is not indicative of future results.

The trading price of a closed-end fund's shares may be influenced by various factors, including market conditions, investor sentiment, and other external forces, and is not directly controlled by the fund, its Board of Trustees, or its investment adviser. As a result, shares may trade at a premium to or discount from NAV at any given time. A premium to NAV may not be sustained, and a discount to NAV may increase or decrease over time. Investors should consider these risks when purchasing or selling closed-end fund shares.

Shareholders whose fund shares trade at a premium to NAV and who participate in the fund's dividend reinvestment plan should be aware that distributions may be reinvested at prices above NAV, which may adversely affect investment results.

Aberdeen Investments Global is the trade name of Aberdeen's investments business, herein referred to as "Aberdeen Investments" or "Aberdeen". In the United States, Aberdeen Investments refers to the following affiliated, registered investment advisers: abrdn Inc., abrdn Investments Limited, and abrdn Asia Limited.

Closed-end funds represent a core component of Aberdeen Investments' client franchise in both the U.S. and global markets.
